rationale: The plan matches the reference exactly on the decisive point: it demonstrates the rank deficiency of ~batch+condition, refuses ComBat/SVA/RUV, fits the only estimable model (~condition, control as reference), and labels every output as a confounded treated_B2 vs control_B1 effect while stating the designs that would resolve it. QC is thorough (library sizes, VST, PCA with variance, correlation clustering, colored by condition/batch) though the outlier policy is only a caution rather than a rule, and the count filter (>=10 in >=6) is reasonable but given as an example without much justification. Normalization is correctly inside DESeq2/edgeR on raw counts, though size factors/TMM are not named explicitly; BH at 0.05 with apeglm/ashr shrinkage is stated, but the |LFC|>1 cut is applied post hoc rather than via lfcThreshold. Enrichment was not asked and arguably not warranted under perfect confounding, but it is specified well (shrunk-LFC ranking stated, 15-500 size window, versioned human GMTs, filtered-gene universe for ORA) and framed as diagnostic; package versions are not explicitly required in the report.
